content:
Maya: quick flag — canary routing for org 'redwood-test' is sending ~4% to projectless bucket and it's spiking quotas
Sam: saw alerts, thought it was monitoring noise. thanks for catching
Jorge: are those requests with api-keys or SA tokens?
Maya: sampling shows api-keys; introspector returns project_id=null even though X-Project-ID header present
Nikki: that smells like middleware ordering. header->claim shim might be running after rate-limit lookup
Erin: can you paste a router trace fragment?
Maya: trace:
[6182435610.001] TRACE router recv tx=tx-9a8b
[6182435610.002] TRACE auth introspect => claims:{iss:api-key, project_id:null, org_id:"redwood-test"}
[6182435610.003] DECISION router: project_claim missing -> consult header X-Project-ID (proj-42) -> header-mapper null (runs after rate-limit)
Sam: we moved header normalization into a shared filter in rollout #4512 and intentionally placed it after rate-limit check to avoid cache explosion
Jorge: centralizing made sense, but it didn't populate claims for routing cache keys for api-keys
Nikki: confirmed. the shim was post-rate-limit which prevents router from seeing project during lookup
Erin: options:
- move shim before rate-limit (fast, increases cache cardinality)
- teach router to read raw headers as fallback (bigger change)
- special-case api-keys in introspector to copy header (hacky)
Tony: prefer correctness for canary. revert shim order for canary and add an allowlist guard to cap cardinality
Maya: agree. plan: reorder shim for 10% canary, monitor projectless_route_pct per-org, then expand if metrics stable
Nikki: I'll open a small PR with shim reorder + config shim.allowlist_projects. will include unit tests
deploy-bot: deploy request created: PR #5872 -> staging-canary (10%). CI passed
Erin: I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert if projectless_route_pct > 1% sustained
Sam: include trace link in alert body for quick triage
Jorge: looping infra to confirm rate-limit cache impact for 10%
Maya: watching dashboard for 30m. if no regressions we move to 50%
Tony: will prepare rollback notes and a short post-mortem template
Maya: also add an integration test that asserts header->claim mapping for api-keys
Sam: thanks all
